title: Figures 105-106: cylinder UAP pressure and temperature at 900 mph supersonic CFD
description: Two CFD contour plots for the cylinder UAP at 1/6 scale, 223K and 900 mph with supersonic inlet and supersonic outlet. Figure 105 shows the pressure field (Pa) with a detached bow shock ahead of the flat face; Figure 106 shows the temperature field (K) with a hot wake behind the body. Supersonic case of the BAASS cylinder analysis.
